goal: Confirm the approved Q02-INF product contract, its owner boundaries, and the complete requirement trace without redefining Q05-LIT-ADD or adjacent generic policy.
description: Scope: Requirements.md, Plan.md, the approved docs/design/Styio-Callable-Principal-Inference.md and docs/design/Styio-Exact-Literals-and-Builtin-Add.md owners, and upstream Q02-SIG/Q04/Q05/F02/Q10 boundaries. Context: Q02-INF and Q05-LIT-ADD are approved; Q02 retains and solves callable constraints while the sibling Q05 lifecycle owns the exact-literal and finite scalar catalog. Target: keep REQ-CPI-001..REQ-CPI-011 complete, user-observable, and bounded to eligible implicit rank-1 callable inference plus concrete specialization. Design Considerations: distinguish equality/generalization and catalog-consumption policy from the Q05-owned rows and from author-written/public generics. Design Value: prevents implementation convenience from reopening a decided contract, cloning the catalog, or stealing an adjacent decision. Constraints & Risks: module-private source visibility remains Q10-owned; if either semantic owner changes, update all requirement and validation mappings before implementation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Requirements.md states users, scope, non-goals, non-functional constraints, and final acceptance for REQ-CPI-001..REQ-CPI-011.

The equality-only identity contract is testable without an uncontextualized numeric literal, while REQ-CPI-005 explicitly consumes the accepted Q05 catalog through a non-owning integration boundary.

goal: Verify every callable inference, concrete type, call, operator, lowering, backend, IDE/cache, test, and removal path before implementation.
description: Scope: Evidence.md plus read-only inspection of StyioParser, StyioAST, StyioSema, StyioSession TypeTable, StyioLowering, StyioIR, StyioCodeGen, IDE/SemDB, CMake, tests, and the exact Q02/Q05 owner documents and sibling delivery boundary. Context: current behavior parses the target source but permanently writes the first argument type into ParamAST, caches one concrete return per function, and lowers unresolved callables through i64 defaults. Target: cite symbol-level facts, inventory all definition/call/boundary/type-constructor routes, confirm test registration, identify the Q05 catalog consumer interface and a stable definition fingerprint source, and measure evidence for deterministic specialization budgets. Design Considerations: compare the scoped inference/canonicalization/worklist design with primary Rust, OCaml, GHC, and Haskell sources while keeping Styio's smaller closed rank-1 domain. Design Value: prevents a partial parser/Sema patch, duplicate numeric catalog, unstable cache key, or unmeasured code-growth policy. Constraints & Risks: the accepted Q05 rows are never copied from current code; observation and inference remain explicitly separated.

goal: Freeze the inference-domain, fact-table, Q05 relation seam, concrete identity, specialization, IR/backend, diagnostics, IDE/cache, and deletion architecture.
description: Scope: Architecture.md, final module/file map, interface headers/scaffold, and build/test wiring decisions; no incomplete behavior is claimed as a product delivery. Context: TypeInfer.cpp, AstToStyioIR.cpp, and CodeGenG.cpp currently combine unrelated responsibilities and share mutable AST/concrete fallback state. Target: specify one-responsibility inference modules, arena/union-find data structures, canonical scheme and call facts, solved TypeTable reification, stable full keys, bounded worklist specialization, concrete-only SGIR, shared IDE/diagnostic/cache facts, a non-owning Q05 catalog adapter, and one-shot migration. Design Considerations: dependency arrows flow from AST/resolution into the inference domain, immutable facts, specializer, concrete IR, and backend; Q05 enters only through its sibling-owned closed catalog; patterns are justified by isolation, determinism, complexity, and testability. Design Value: lets later nodes own disjoint modules and removes the need for a second inferencer, numeric table, or runtime generic ABI. Constraints & Risks: do not introduce source generic syntax, raw-pointer/session-ordinal cache identity, duplicated Add rows, elapsed-time gates, or a new all-purpose file; architecture changes require checkpoint/file-ownership updates first.

goal: Implement and verify the scoped type-term, constraint, unification, canonicalization, and solved-type reification core.

Context: StyioDataType/TypeTable model only concrete types, while Undefined currently conflates unknown, wildcard, and fallback. Target: provide dense arena IDs, structural terms for supported constructors, equality/operator fact shapes, compact origins, union-find with path compression/rank and occurs checks, canonical scheme variables/constraints, ambiguity hooks, and reification that returns TypeId only when fully solved. Design Value: creates a sound near-linear reusable domain core instead of growing TypeInfer.cpp or abusing global concrete interning. Constraints & Risks: no production callable route switches in this node, no Q02-local Q05 catalog row, no TypeVar in TypeTable/AST/SGIR, and every new source/test must be linked by CMake.

goal: Replace callable definition/body inference with canonical principal schemes and explicit generalization eligibility.

Context: callable declarations currently register syntax only, infer bodies on demand under concrete mutated parameters, and merge one return type per function. Target: generate definition terms/constraints, infer identity relationships, instantiate nested scheme calls symbolically, attach one concrete finite completion summary, prove final/non-recursive/non-boundary/capture-safe eligibility, generalize only environment-free variables, publish immutable canonical schemes, and diagnose ambiguity/ineligibility at the definition. Design Considerations: use an eligibility proof object and resolved definition identities; keep module-private eligibility conditional on Q10's concrete visibility classification; explicitly typed monomorphic callables use the same fact API. Design Value: makes schemes depend only on definitions/environment/expected contracts and gives all consumers one stable semantic fact. Constraints & Risks: no call-set scan, weak mutable variable, hidden public generic ABI, implicit polymorphic recursion, AST scheme storage, or Q05 relation implementation; shared Sema files remain serially owned through the next node.

Context: the current call checker permanently executes ParamAST::setDataType on its first concrete argument and records one return cache, so correct later calls are order-dependent. goal: Implement stable concrete specialization planning, bounded reachability, and concrete SGFunc/SGCall lowering.
description: Scope: new src/StyioLowering/CallableSpecialization.*, AstToStyioIR.cpp/AstToStyioIRLowerer.hpp integration, concrete fingerprint support in StyioSession, SGFunc/SGCall shape in src/StyioIR/GenIR/SGIR.hpp, StyioIR verifier, frontend CMake wiring, and lowering/IR tests. Context: lowering currently emits one source-named function, defaults unspecified signatures to i64, and cannot distinguish instances. Target: derive full stable DefinitionKey/SpecializationKey values, discover reachable concrete instances with a deduplicating stateful worklist, lower each under its concrete substitution, resolve nested calls, keep SGType concrete, carry matching concrete call result/signature, omit unused generic definitions, and sort emission deterministically. Design Considerations: insert before body lowering for same-key cycles; reject growing recursive keys; charge evidence-backed per-definition/session/constraint/code-size budgets before allocation; use full canonical key comparison after hashing. Design Value: turns proven schemes into optimized concrete code while making recursion, code growth, and identity observable and bounded. Constraints & Risks: no raw SymbolId/TypeId ordinal or std::hash in persisted/mangled identity, no generic SGType/runtime dictionary, no direct default lowering of a source generic definition, and no backend fallback.

goal: Emit and execute only the verified concrete callable instances and remove backend result/signature repair.
description: Scope: src/StyioCodeGen/GetTypeG.cpp, CodeGenG.cpp, backend CMake wiring, codegen/JIT/end-to-end/security tests, and IR-to-LLVM signature diagnostics. Context: codegen currently finds one function by source name, coerces arguments to its signature, and may type a missing call result as i64. Target: declare all stable concrete instance signatures, define each once, emit calls by the verified SGCall identity/signature/result, reject missing/mismatched instances, preserve deterministic declaration/definition order, and record generated function/code-size metrics. Design Value: closes the semantic-to-runtime loop and ensures LLVM cannot silently choose a type or first instance. Constraints & Risks: preserve explicit native/runtime call routes outside generic Styio callable specialization, do not leak host/toolchain data in diagnostics, and coordinate with unrelated dirty CodeGenG.cpp edits without reverting them.

goal: Publish one source-located scheme/call diagnostic model and one deterministic IDE/incremental-cache fact model.
description: Scope: focused StyioSema diagnostic rendering, immutable callable/call fact interfaces, src/StyioServices/StyioIDE/CompilerBridge.cpp and owning HIR/SemDB/cache modules, IDE/security tests, and cache metrics. Context: IDE currently observes only concrete local types/function definitions, while future scheme/call facts would be unsafe to cache by arena IDs, AST pointers, or call sets. Target: render canonical compiler meta-notation and bounded origin traces, distinguish definition ambiguity/generalization from call relation/mismatch and specialization failures, publish scheme/call result facts to IDE, and key/invalidate caches from stable definition/environment/expected-contract/operation/Q05/config fingerprints. Constraints & Risks: meta-notation is not new source syntax, diagnostics/caches contain no runtime values/secrets or disallowed host paths, and module-private exposure remains subject to Q10 visibility facts.
